content.text: {"affected_statement":"L3.3","objection_correct":"yes","established_elsewhere":"no","elsewhere_quote":null,"status_as_written":"not_established","repair_distance":"lemma","explanation":"The cancellation argument covers only replies that split each of the n large pieces exactly once. Replies using fewer cuts or concentrating several cuts in one initial segment are not handled for general n; only n=2 examples are given, and the write-up explicitly says the claim still needs proof. Thus no universal lower-bound mechanism equivalent to L3.3 is established. Moreover, the proposed constant (n+1)/(2n+1) differs from the required 2^n/(2^(n+1)-1) for n>1."}
